question: Should this security-sensitive external PR be required to provide standalone actual-setup runtime output, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate based on its real-logger Vitest coverage?
rationale: Repository policy treats tests and harness-generated JSONL as supplemental rather than sufficient real-behavior proof, so bypassing that requirement requires an explicit human decision.

options.title: Require standalone runtime proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or runtime logs from an actual OpenClaw setup before exact-head security approval.

options.title: Explicitly override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the existing real-logger Vitest evidence as sufficient for this non-network redaction path and record the override before merge.

recommendation.title: Require standalone runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or runtime logs from an actual OpenClaw setup before exact-head security approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the latest security hardening commits, requested review, and are best positioned to judge whether the exact-head proof merits an explicit exception.
